integrity: The proof is analytical and self-contained modulo the cited general free-lattice norm theorem and standard finite-dimensional convex duality. Exact integer spectral verification and numerical nonsymmetric-design checks are auxiliary. No external independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to real free 2-convex Banach lattices over Euclidean spaces, the triangular Johnson graph on two-subsets, and positive row amplitudes. Complete norm profile assumes a common amplitude for disjoint pairs; the no-growth theorem allows nonuniform subfamily amplitudes. No formula for other free-lattice exponents or general Johnson ranks is asserted. Bibliographic identity under different terminology remains possible.
title: Exact two-orbit two-summing transition for triangular Johnson graphs
